defects.expected: help text: 'blocks execution until confirmation by the user'; line 21 comment: 'stall only if we are NOT on jenkins! I.e. not on the CI' -> ask outside jenkins only

notes: LEAD DECISION: severity. The condition at line 20 is the negation of its own comment (line 21) and of the help text, unchanged since the file was added; I classed it wrong-result (strict reading of the brief), which quarantines it and blocks its untested callers (INIT, OptKnock, SteadyCom, fastcc, iMAT, optForce, optGene, prepareFastGapFill call it on models with C/E fields; the defect is in every call, not confined to a call form). testOptKnock and testOptForce already skip it on jenkins homes. If the lead downgrades to limitation, a passing TESTED version is ready at <helper scratch folder>/w08b/alt/testIssueConfirmationWarning.m (verified with run_coverage in place: passed, 8 lines, missed [22, 23, 24] = exempt as interactive input; checks lastwarn equals the message and that a dummy warning id switched off before the call is off again; guarded by the jenkins-HOME check like testOptKnock). Repro: issueConfirmationWarning('probe message') on a normal machine returns at once after the warning; setenv('HOME','/var/lib/jenkins'); issueConfirmationWarning('x') -> MissingRequiredCapability error in -batch (restore HOME afterwards). Side note: the message is the only argument of warning(), so escape sequences in the callers' messages ('\n') are not converted and '%d' is shown literally (probe).
confirmed_by: lead (source read: line 20 stalls only when HOME contains jenkins, the reverse of the header (blocks until confirmation) and of the comment on line 21)
